svg.title: Retry with exponential backoff
svg.desc: A failed call is retried after waits that double each time, giving the service room to recover. Waits are shown by the client's badge and by phase lengths in proportion (1s, then 2s). The retry counter ticks when a retry is sent, against a budget of 3. A real policy keeps doubling up to a cap, gives up when the budget is spent, and adds random jitter so clients don't retry in sync. Only idempotent calls should be retried. 1. Call fails: the overloaded service returns an error. 2. Back off 1s: the client waits before retrying. 3. Retry 1 fails: still overloaded, another error. 4. Back off 2s: the wait doubles. 5. Retry 2 succeeds: the service has recovered. 6. Reset: success resets the retry budget.
svg.text: A failed call is retried after waits that double each time, giving the service room to recover

g.text: the overloaded service returns an error
